Unavailable component (contract rule 7, replacing web L18/34/45/56/67/78/89/100/111/122/133/144 lazy DOM-component loaders): createUnavailableWidget(name) keeps the web LazyExoticComponent<ComponentType<WidgetProps>> component shape (so the registry stays renderable + faithful) but resolves via Promise.resolve to a native View+AppText surface that renders an explicit '{name} unavailable' caption with an accessibilityLabel '{name} is not yet available in the native app'. The twelve system web widget components are not yet ported into web-parity, so a copied lazy import would reference non-existent modules and break typecheck; the explicit unavailable state is the native-safe substitute. Matches the established precedent from the already-ported sibling registry/climate.ts.

DOM/web -> React Native: no DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported. Imports limited to react (createElement/lazy + ComponentType/LazyExoticComponent types), react-native (StyleSheet/View), the existing native AppText (tone='muted'/variant='caption'), and the theme spacing token. StyleSheet keys (unavailable, unavailableText) and properties are alphabetically sorted for the react-native/sort-styles rule. Relative import depth is 5 levels (../../../../../) from the registry/ folder to src/components and src/theme. State names: none in source; API paths: none; unit handling: none. i18n: the web source uses raw English literals for name/description (no t()), preserved verbatim; the onboarding-checklist help.i18nKey 'checklist.help' + defaultValue carry the i18n intent and are ported 1:1. Visual intent (icon identity per tile + grid sizes + help metadata) preserved.
